objective: Proof: additivity of bond distance minus one across separating distinctions in complement-closed bases; the block reduction of the triangle inequality; bond distance on rings of knots; split bases have bond distance at most two.
status: Proved 2026-11-18 (referee pending): on complement-closed bases (every not-all-equal and betweenness base, any arity; also parity where the joint is not fixed) the bonds at a separating distinction are the two sides' and their joins, so bond distance minus one adds across it; bond distance is a metric exactly when it is one on every block; rings of not-all-equal-class knots have b = steps apart + 1 on every pair, so every tree of knots and rings has b - 1 = steps apart; split bases have b <= 2 exactly when every separated pair has a third between (lines and full grids).
title: Cuts, blocks, rings and split bases
